svg.title: A leaf getting sick before it looks sick
svg.desc: An ASCII leaf drawn as a clean line drawing, with two scrolling sensor traces (humidity, leaf temperature) and a p(disease) meter. As a simulated lesion field grows from three infection sites, the meter fed by image and sensor evidence turns red with an early warning while the leaf still looks almost clean; only later do the spots show. Then a new sample is swept in from the left.
